mapper.select: select k.id, k.subject_id, k.name, k.status, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.del_flag, coalesce(c.chunk_count, 0) as chunk_count from kb_base k left join ( select subject_id, count(1) as chunk_count from kb_chunk group by subject_id ) c on c.subject_id = k.subject_id where k.del_flag = '0' order by k.subject_id asc

select k.id, k.subject_id, k.name, k.status, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.del_flag, coalesce(c.chunk_count, 0) as chunk_count from kb_base k left join ( select subject_id, count(1) as chunk_count from kb_chunk group by subject_id ) c on c.subject_id = k.subject_id where k.subject_id = #{subjectId} and k.del_flag = '0' limit 1
